question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/list request with no initialize handshake (jsonrpc 2.0, id 1, method tools/list, no params), Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream

decoded.challenge: the challenge is the one recorded in the headers field, identical to the one an initialize request drew on 2026-09-17: invalid_token, a description, the protected-resource metadata URL, no realm

finding: A tools/list request carrying no credentials answers 401 with a Bearer challenge and the same JSON error body as an initialize request to the same endpoint, so the endpoint did not return a tool list to this caller. The vendor's MCP page says its tool set splits into "public tools (available without authentication) and authenticated tools"; this record measures only what one anonymous tools/list answered, and no list of tools was returned to read that claim against. Nothing here measures what the endpoint does with a credential, and nothing here establishes why the request was refused.
